title: Wax Heel Solo #17 (왁스 솔로 · 체형 curvy petite · 힐 숫자 없음 · 신발 색 몸 패턴과 일치)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — full body molten wax flowing and set directly over her own skin covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is real wax that has flowed down every curve and hardened in place, each drip and pooled ridge standing in true three-dimensional relief, casting its own small soft shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense flowing drips — BLAZING DEEP VIOLET molten wax streams pooling and hardening across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID ROSE translucent drip-ridges catching the light filling every remaining gap with real depth and texture, each ridge glossy and rounded exactly like real set wax, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels entirely coated in the same hardened wax drips in blazing deep violet and vivid rose, NOT black, NOT dark, NOT plain — the footwear must be a bright, saturated, glossy colour taken straight from her own body art, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, extra long nails with tiny wax drip tips at each nail.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Very low camera angle with the full length of every boot visible down to the floor, the towering heel height dominating the silhouette and lifting her far above the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
